description: Temperature-contour provides short MATLAB scripts for constructing temperature-field contour plots from measurements at different positions under steady conditions. The repository maintained by Tanathepl lists matrix-creation and contour routines for two measurement planes. The accompanying article connects the code to experiments in an insulated box cooled by phase-change material. The v1.0 Zenodo archive is publicly accessible without charge and labels its licence Other (Open); it does not identify full reuse terms. GitHub declares no separate licence. The repository specifies MATLAB on Windows, but not a MATLAB version, a general grid resolution or a temporal coverage. These routines interpolate measured temperatures and do not solve a heat-transfer model. A reviewer-assessed use is preparing spatial comparisons between cold-chain experiments and thermal simulations from model-openfoam. Users must check the expected coordinate arrays and units before comparing fields. The scripts were not downloaded or run, and no interpolation accuracy is asserted.
